Stats: Health: 90, Ability Power: 18
Tags: Health, Lane, ManaRegen, SpellDamage

[Passive] Drain: Restore 1 Mana every second, increased to 2 Mana per second for 5 seconds after dealing damage to an enemy champion. If you can't gain Mana, heal for 45% of this value instead.

[Passive] Helping Hand: Attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to minions.
